name: Electric Motorized Bicycle
description: A two-wheeler with fully operable pedals and an electric motor capable of more than 750 watts that can go faster than 28 mph: a pedaled e-moto. The law counts it as a motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: Two wheels, fully operable pedals and an electric motor capable of more than 750 watts (N.J.S.A. 39:1-1, added by P.L.2025, c.285)
Not a motorized bicycle or low-speed electric bicycle: the definition of motorcycle names it, so motorcycle rules apply (N.J.S.A. 39:1-1)
Riders need a motorcycle license or endorsement
Riders and passengers must wear a motorcycle helmet
Titled, registered and insured as a motorcycle
Selling one online is banned for the year after P.L.2025, c.285 took effect
Selling a kit that turns a low-speed electric bicycle into one is prohibited (P.L.2025, c.285)
